interface.name: xwayland_satellite_settings_v1

description.summary: host appearance for its private X11 compatibility bridge

interface.description: Optional host preference delivery. Only the compositor's authenticated compatibility client may bind. Satellite retains XSettings ownership and its DPI entries; the host supplies the toolkit theme name. The initial event is sent at bind, with later events on preference changes.
